/// 寫入使用者操作紀錄 (Audit Log)

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
/// [action] 動作類型，例如：'登入', '登出', '權限變更', '刪除設備'

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
/// [details] 動作細節，例如：'將 test@email.com 升級為管理員'

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
Future<void> logUserAction(String action, {String details = ''}) async {

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
  try {

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
    // 取得目前登入的使用者

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
    final user = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
    if (user == null || user.email == null) return;

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###


### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
    // 將紀錄寫入 Supabase 資料表

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
    await Supabase.instance.client.from('user_activity_logs').insert({

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
      'user_email': user.email,

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
      'action': action,

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
      'details': details,

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
    });

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
  } catch (e) {

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
    // 寫入失敗不阻斷主流程，僅印出偵錯訊息

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
    debugPrint('寫入操作紀錄失敗: $e');

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
  }

### File: lib/utils/audit_logger.dart ###
}

### File: lib/screens/advanced_settings_screens.dart ###

      _mqttClient?.disconnect();

### File: lib/screens/advanced_settings_screens.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        }

      }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

  /// 🎯 專屬 W410s 的網路 AT 指令配網流程

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
  Future<bool> _configureW410sViaUDP(String ip, String inverterSn) async {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    RawDatagramSocket? udpSocket;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    StreamSubscription? subscription; 

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    try {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      final dtuAddress = InternetAddress(ip);

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      // 動態計算「子網路廣播位址 (Subnet Broadcast)」

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      final ipParts = ip.split('.');

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      if (ipParts.length == 4) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        ipParts[3] = '255';

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      final subnetBroadcastIp = ipParts.join('.');

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      final broadcastAddress = InternetAddress(subnetBroadcastIp);

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      udpSocket = await RawDatagramSocket.bind(InternetAddress.anyIPv4, 0);

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      udpSocket.readEventsEnabled = true;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      udpSocket.broadcastEnabled = true; 

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      List<String> receiveBuffer = [];

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      subscription = udpSocket.listen((RawSocketEvent event) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        if (event == RawSocketEvent.read) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          while (true) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            final datagram = udpSocket?.receive();

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            if (datagram == null) break;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            final resp = utf8.decode(datagram.data, allowMalformed: true);

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            receiveBuffer.add(resp);

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            debugPrint('<= 接收: $resp');

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      });

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      Future<void> sendAT(String cmd, {bool expectOk = true, InternetAddress? targetIp}) async {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        receiveBuffer.clear(); 

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        final target = targetIp ?? dtuAddress; 

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        debugPrint('=> 發送至 ${target.address}: ${cmd.replaceAll('\r', '<CR>').replaceAll('\n', '<LF>')}');

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          if (receiveBuffer.isNotEmpty) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
              isSuccess = true;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            } else {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
              if (receiveBuffer.any((msg) => msg.contains('+OK'))) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
                isSuccess = true;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
                break;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
              }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            throw Exception('指令逾時無回應 ($cmd)');

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          } else {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
            throw Exception('指令執行失敗或未包含 +OK: ${receiveBuffer.join(" | ")}');

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      // ---------------------------------------------------------

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      // Step 1: 喚醒設備 (🎯 加入防掉包的連環敲門機制)

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      // ---------------------------------------------------------

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      // 連續廣播 3 次通關密語，每次間隔 300 毫秒，克服 UDP 掉包與 ARP 冷啟動延遲

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      // ---------------------------------------------------------

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

      await sendAT('AT+MQTTEN=ON\r\n');

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
  Future<void> _testDtuConnection() async {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    final ip = _dtuIpController.text.trim();

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    if (ip.isEmpty) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      _showSnackBar('請先輸入DTU的IP位址');

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      return;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    setState(() { _isPinging = true; });

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    try {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      bool isOnline = false;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      // 方法一：嘗試對 Port 80 建立 TCP 連線 (多數 DTU 有網頁後台)

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      // 這個方法在 iOS/Android 上最穩定，不易被系統防火牆擋下

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      try {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        final socket = await Socket.connect(ip, 80, timeout: const Duration(seconds: 2));

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        isOnline = true;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        socket.destroy();

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      } catch (_) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        // 方法二：如果 Port 80 不通，則退回使用系統內建的 ICMP Ping 指令

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        try {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          final result = await Process.run('ping', ['-c', '1', '-W', '2', ip]);

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          if (result.exitCode == 0) isOnline = true;

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        } catch (_) {}

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      if (mounted) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        if (isOnline) {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('✅ DTU連線測試成功', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.black87, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)), backgroundColor: Colors.orangeAccent));

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        } else {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('❌ DTU連線測試失敗，請確認手機與DTU是否在相同網路區段'), backgroundColor: Colors.redAccent));

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
        }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    } finally {

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
      if (mounted) setState(() { _isPinging = false; });

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/w410s_provisioning_screen.dart ###
  }

  final String errorMsg = e.toString();

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
  if (errorMsg.contains('SocketException') || errorMsg.contains('Failed host lookup')) {

    return '無法連線至雲端伺服器，請檢查您的 Wi-Fi 或網路連線狀態。';

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
  }

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
  return '錯誤細節: $errorMsg';

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
}

  Future<void> _handleSecureLogout() async {

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
    setState(() { _isActionLoading = true; }); 

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
    try {

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      final user = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      if (user != null) {

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
        await Supabase.instance.client

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
            .from('profiles')

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
            .update({'fcm_token': null})

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
            .eq('id', user.id);

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      // 🎯 紀錄: 登出 (依照平台給予不同的細節描述)

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      String platform = kIsWeb ? '網頁版後台' : '手機 APP';

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      await logUserAction('登出', details: '使用者從 $platform 登出系統');

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
    } catch (e) {

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      debugPrint('清除 FCM Token 失敗: $e');

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
    } finally {

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      await widget.onLogout();

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
      if (mounted) {

### File: lib/screens/profile_screen.dart ###
        setState(() { _isActionLoading = false; });

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
  Future<void> _fetchExistingDeviceSpecs() async {

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
    try {

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      if (widget.deviceDbId.isEmpty) return;

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      final data = await Supabase.instance.client

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
          .from('devices')

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
          .select('sn, address, created_at')

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
          .eq('id', widget.deviceDbId)

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
          .single();

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      _snController.text = data['sn'] ?? '';

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      if (data['created_at'] != null) {

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
        DateTime dt = DateTime.parse(data['created_at']);

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
        _dateController.text = "${dt.year}-${dt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${dt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      } else {

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
        _dateController.text = "尚未紀錄";

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      String addr = data['address'] ?? '';

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      for (var city in _taiwanLocations.keys) {

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
        if (addr.contains(city)) {

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
          _selectedCity = city;

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
          for (var dist in _taiwanLocations[city]!) {

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
            if (addr.contains(dist)) _selectedDistrict = dist;

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
          }

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
        }

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      _fetchBatteries();

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
    } catch (e) {

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
      if (mounted) setState(() { _dateController.text = "尚未紀錄"; _isLoadingBatteries = false; });

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/device_info_settings_screen.dart ###
  }

  Widget _buildMessageWithLinks(String text) {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    final urlRegExp = RegExp(r'(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)');

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    final Iterable<RegExpMatch> matches = urlRegExp.allMatches(text);

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    if (matches.isEmpty) {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      return Text(text, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, color: Colors.black87, height: 1.6));

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    List<TextSpan> spans = [];

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    int lastMatchEnd = 0;

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    for (var match in matches) {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      final String url = match.group(0)!;

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      if (match.start > lastMatchEnd) {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
        spans.add(TextSpan(text: text.substring(lastMatchEnd, match.start)));

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      spans.add(

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
        TextSpan(

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
          text: url,

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.blueAccent, decoration: TextDecoration.underline),

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
          recognizer: TapGestureRecognizer()..onTap = () async {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
            final uri = Uri.parse(url);

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
            if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
              await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
            }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
          },

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
        ),

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      );

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      lastMatchEnd = match.end;

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    if (lastMatchEnd < text.length) {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      spans.add(TextSpan(text: text.substring(lastMatchEnd)));

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    return RichText(

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      text: TextSpan(

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, color: Colors.black87, height: 1.6),

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
        children: spans,

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
      ),

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
    );

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/inner_dashboard.dart ###
  }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/data_alarm_screens.dart ###
    if (rawTime == null || rawTime.isEmpty) return '--:--:--';

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/data_alarm_screens.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/data_alarm_screens.dart ###
      DateTime dt = DateTime.parse(rawTime);

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/data_alarm_screens.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/data_alarm_screens.dart ###
    } catch (e) {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/data_alarm_screens.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/data_alarm_screens.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/data_alarm_screens.dart ###
  }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (wx.contains('雷')) return 95;

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (wx.contains('雨') || wx.contains('陣雨')) return 80;

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    return 0;

  }

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
  WeatherCondition _getWeatherCondition(int code) {

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (_isTyphoonWarning) return WeatherCondition.typhoon; 

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (code < 0) return WeatherCondition.sunny; 

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (code == 0) return WeatherCondition.sunny; 

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (code >= 1 && code <= 3) return WeatherCondition.partlyCloudy; 

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (code >= 4 && code <= 7) return WeatherCondition.cloudy; 

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (code == 23 || code == 37 || code == 42) return WeatherCondition.snow; 

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (code >= 95 && code < 99) return WeatherCondition.thunderstorm; 

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if (code == 99) return WeatherCondition.typhoon; 

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    if ((code >= 51 && code <= 65) || (code >= 80 && code <= 82)) return WeatherCondition.rainy;

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
    return WeatherCondition.sunny;

### File: lib/screens/dashboard/home_screen.dart ###
  }

  void _initLoginTimer() {

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
    final user = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
      _loginTime = DateTime.now();

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
      final now = DateTime.now();

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
      final timeStr = "${now.year}/${now.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${now.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.second.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
        });

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
    });

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
  }

  Future<void> _fetchUserProfile() async {

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/web_admin_screen.dart ###

  /// Step 1: 登入並獲取 Token

### File: lib/screens/network_provisioning_screen.dart ###
  Future<Map<String, String>> _loginAndGetLuciToken(String ip) async {

### File: lib/screens/network_provisioning_screen.dart ###

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
  Future<void> _fetchCurrentTariff() async {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    try {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      if (widget.deviceDbId.isEmpty) return;

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      final data = await Supabase.instance.client

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
          .from('devices')

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
          .select('electricity_tariff, custom_tariff_rate')

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
          .eq('id', widget.deviceDbId)

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
          .single();

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      if (mounted) {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        setState(() {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
          _selectedTariff = data['electricity_tariff'] ?? '一般累進表燈(住商)';

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
          _customRate = double.tryParse((data['custom_tariff_rate'] ?? 3.5).toString()) ?? 3.5;

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
          _rateController.text = _customRate.toString();

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
          _isLoading = false;

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        });

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    } catch (e) {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      if (mounted) {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars(); 

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(_getFriendlyErrorMsg(e)), backgroundColor: Colors.redAccent));

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
  }

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
  Future<void> _saveTariffToSupabase() async {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    if (widget.deviceDbId.isEmpty) return;

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    try {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      Map<String, dynamic> updateData = {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        'electricity_tariff': _selectedTariff,

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      };

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      if (_selectedTariff == '一般累進表燈(住商)') {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        double parsedRate = double.tryParse(_rateController.text) ?? 3.5;

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        updateData['custom_tariff_rate'] = parsedRate;

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      await Supabase.instance.client.from('devices').update(updateData).eq('id', widget.deviceDbId);

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      // 🎯 紀錄: 變更電價方案

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      await logUserAction('更改電價方案', details: '變更為「$_selectedTariff」');

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###


### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      if (mounted) {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars(); 

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('設定完成'), backgroundColor: Colors.teal));

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        Navigator.pop(context);

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    } catch (e) {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      if (mounted) {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars(); 

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(_getFriendlyErrorMsg(e)), backgroundColor: Colors.redAccent));

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    } finally {

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSaving = false);

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/screens/settings_screens.dart ###
  }

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
  Offset _calculateCelestialPosition(Size size, double hour) {

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    double progress = 0.0;

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    if (hour >= 6 && hour < 18) {

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
      progress = (hour - 6) / 12.0; 

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    } else {

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
      double nightHour = hour >= 18 ? (hour - 18) : (hour + 6);

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
      progress = nightHour / 12.0;

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###


### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    double x = size.width * (0.1 + progress * 0.8);

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    // 🎯 讓拋物線的高低落差更大，0.3 讓太陽在早晚會沉得更低，營造「落日」感

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    double yOffset = pow((progress - 0.5) * 2, 2).toDouble(); 

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    double y = size.height * 0.1 + (size.height * 0.3 * yOffset);

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###


### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
    return Offset(x, y);

### File: lib/widgets/weather_renderer.dart ###
  }

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###


### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###


### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###


### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
      String cleanHex = inputText.replaceAll(' ', '');

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
      List<int> bytesList = [];

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
      for (int i = 0; i < cleanHex.length; i += 2) {

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
        bytesList.add(int.parse(cleanHex.substring(i, i + 2), radix: 16));

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
      }

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
      payloadBytes = Uint8List.fromList(bytesList);

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
    }

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###


### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
    final buffer = Uint8Buffer()..addAll(payloadBytes);

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
    builder.addBuffer(buffer);

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###


### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###


### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
    });

### File: lib/widgets/command_test_dialog.dart ###
  }
